div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HEARTBEAT · every 60 s
POST /api/playback/heartbeat
up: alive · now playing · schedule version
down: reload flag + due screenshot jobs

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PROOF OF PLAY · separate channel
POST /api/playback/proof
BATCHED — up to 200 signed plays per request
own WorkManager worker, ~1 upload / 60 s
offline → queued on disk, uploaded later

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NO WEBSOCKET
nothing held open, so Cloud Run stays stateless
and scales to any fleet size
cost: an edit lands within one heartbeat

span.p:
WEB CMS · operators
Next.js 15 App Router · React 19 · TypeScript 5
Tailwind CSS v4 · lucide-react · framer-motion
Vitest · deployed on Cloud Run

div.style: color: rgb(21, 58, 158) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PLAYER APK · the screens
Kotlin 2.0 · Gradle KTS · minSdk 24 / target 34
Media3 ExoPlayer (video) · Coil (images)
Retrofit + OkHttp + kotlinx.serialization
WorkManager (uploads) · DataStore (cache)
Android Keystore — ECDSA P-256 signing

div.style: color: rgb(21, 58, 158) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PARTNER PLATFORM
third-party reseller · any HTTP client

div.style: color: rgb(12, 80, 40) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FastAPI 0.115 · Uvicorn · Python 3.12 · Poetry
Pydantic v2 + pydantic-settings
PyJWT HS256 · pbkdf2_sha256 (stdlib) · cryptography (ECDSA verify)
Pillow · openpyxl · aiosmtplib
CI: Cloud Build on push to main → Artifact Registry

div.style: color: rgb(106, 62, 5) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PostgreSQL — Google Cloud SQL
SQLAlchemy 2.0 async + asyncpg (runtime)
Alembic + psycopg2 (migrations)
SOURCE OF TRUTH — 19 tables

div.style: color: rgb(106, 62, 5) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Redis 5
AI stream pub/sub
per-session turn locks
degrades in-process if down

ad creatives (direct resumable upload)
+ milestone screenshots (kept forever)
